{{Top|leg}}
'''Docking Bay 12: 421''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] on [[Nwarcol Point]]. A group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] contracted by [[Mal Biron]] were ordered to berth at Docking Bat 12: 421 when they docked at the station. During their visit, they met [[Nile Audo]], who transferred cargo into their possession.<ref name="SSR">''[[Secrets of the Sisar Run]]''</ref>
